rules.notes: safe_harbor=full per Bugcrowd dump (full safe harbor confirmed). managed_by_bugcrowd=true (Bugcrowd-managed engagement, not self-managed). per-asset severity_cap not in Bugcrowd dump; defaulted to unknown for all entries. bounty table coarse-grained — only max_payout known from dump (0,000 USD); manually refine from engagement Rewards tab if drafting against medium/low severity. mass_scanning_allowed defaulted to false (safe default; confirm on engagement page). automated_tools_allowed defaulted to false (safe default; confirm on engagement page). cve_age_min_days defaulted to 30 (safe default; not stated in dump). requires_ownership_proof defaulted to true (safe default; fintech sensitivity). bucket_download_allowed defaulted to false (safe default). FINTECH: Chime is a US neobank — live customer account testing almost certainly prohibited; use QA/sandbox environments explicitly in scope: member-qa.chime.com/enroll and app-qa.chime.com/users/sign_in. Do NOT test against production accounts holding real customer funds (FDIC-adjacent risk, financial transaction integrity). PII and financial account data must not be exfiltrated even as PoC. Salt Labs (*.saltlabs.com, app.saltlabs.com, staging.saltlabs.com, mobile apps) is a Chime subsidiary; treat with same fintech care. allows_disclosure=false per dump; coordinate any disclosure through Bugcrowd. submission_form is best-guess URL; confirm once on bugcrowd.com/engagements/chime before pasting. *.chimebank.com dump entry had trailing tab character — normalized to *.chimebank.com.
